overclaims: Public company statements before the post do point to gigawatt-scale capacity: Google TPU capacity 'well over a gigawatt' expected in 2026 (e2), over a million Trainium2 chips in use, and nearly 1GW more from Amazon by end of 2026 (e3).
Company announcements are forward-looking and not independently verified.
checks.note: E3 describes nearly 1GW total coming online during 2026. It does not establish nearly 1GW more beyond capacity already in use in April. The limitation also treats the announcements as wholly forward-looking, although e3 reports current chip use. Preserve that distinction.

overclaims: On the other side, detailed daily price benchmarks and some contract disclosures do exist.
This is context showing the opacity concern is widely shared.
checks.note: The evidence supports a published daily benchmark but supplies no contract disclosures. One IEEE Spectrum article shows that another publication raised the opacity concern, not that the concern is widely shared. Remove or narrow those assertions.
